description.value: You envelope yourself in a field of temporal-aetheric drag that slows the casting process for all spellcasters other than yourself within range. While you sustain this spell, any creature within the 60-foot emanation (other than you) that casts a spell requires one additional action beyond the spell's normal casting time. Spells that normally require 1 action to cast require 2 actions; spells requiring 2 actions require 3 actions; spells requiring 3 actions cannot be cast at all while within the emanation. Free-action and reaction spells are unaffected.
